Ran into Priya at the coffee place on Lamar Street and we did the thing where you both pretend you have somewhere to be, except neither of us did, so eventually we just sat down. Forty minutes. Best part of the week and it wasn't on any list.

I think about that a lot, actually. The stuff that turns out to matter almost never makes it onto the calendar, and the stuff on the calendar is mostly a tax I'm paying to keep some larger machine from noticing me. Which sounds bleaker than I mean it. The machine is fine. I like the machine. But it does have opinions about where my Tuesdays go, and its opinions are not mine.

She asked what I was working on and I gave the two-sentence version, the one that sounds coherent. Then she asked a follow-up and the whole thing fell apart in about nine seconds, because the honest answer is that I've been circling it for a month and calling the circling progress. That was useful. Uncomfortable and useful, in that order.

Anyway. More coffee, fewer calendars. That's the whole insight. Not much of one but I'll take it.

Best,
Akshay
